svg.title: Red Yellow Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Japan Art Association award biography explicitly credits Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo and supplies 165.1 x 495.3 cm; source museum’s current size, 165.3 × 495.8 cm, retained. Three equal adjoining color panels in red-yellow-blue order. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
